```{r}
source("BiodivAF.R")
source("BiodivAF-check.R")
library(patchwork)   # for arranging multiple ggplots
library(gridExtra)   # for empty placeholder text

# Preallocate things needed and run
optie <- "Dependant validation set"
mods <- c("Climate", "forestshrub_frac", "Soil_type", "Shrub_layer", "Tree.pol", "Org.Conv", "Tree_SR", "Age")

SA.add <- FALSE

source("Model_updates.R") # Uncomment if you want to run the model updates first
```

## Generate predictions
```{r}
# Load all model files
model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^model_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)

# Load model and predict with random rows
preds_random <- predict_from_saved_rma_model(model_files[2]) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
preds_random

# Run predictions for all models
all_preds <- purrr::map_dfr(model_files, ~predict_from_saved_rma_model(.x)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
all_preds
```

## Find outlyers
```{r}
outliers <- all_preds %>%
  mutate(is_outlier = abs(ROM_Pred) > 5) %>%
  filter(is_outlier)
outliers
```

```{r}
validation <- readRDS("Validation_data")  %>%
  mutate(crtl_mean = ifelse(Metric %in% c("ab", "SR", "totSR"), crtl_mean + 1, crtl_mean), # Solve 0-values: transform to + 1
         AF_mean = ifelse(Metric %in% c("ab", "SR", "totSR"), AF_mean + 1, AF_mean)) %>%
  mutate(yi = log(AF_mean/crtl_mean))
validation

# Load all model files
model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^model_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)

# Run predictions for validation set
all_preds <- purrr::map_dfr(model_files, ~predict_from_saved_rma_model(.x, validation)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
all_preds

# Plot: metafor prediction vs factual data (for Percent: aes(x = yi_Percent, y = Percent_Pred))
p1 <- ggplot(all_preds, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(
    x = "Raw data (ROM)",
    y = "Metafor Prediction (ROM)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
p1

p1 + xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(-5, 5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

results <- evaluate_model(all_preds)
results 
all_preds %>% arrange(yi)
```
